name: context-menu
title: Context Menu 右键菜单
description: 在区域内右键（触屏长按）打开的操作菜单。

whenToUse: 为文件、列表项、画布元素等区域提供右键快捷操作
需要复选项、单选项或子菜单的上下文操作

whenNotToUse.case: 页面上唯一的操作入口（右键难以被发现）
桌面应用顶部常驻的命令菜单

accessibility: 触发区域聚焦后支持 Shift+F10 和菜单键，菜单内支持方向键、回车、Esc 和子菜单导航
同样的操作应在可见的按钮或菜单中也能完成；Shortcut 只是快捷键提示，快捷键需另行实现
responsive: 触屏通过长按打开，用户不易发现，移动端要提供可见入口
菜单靠近边缘时自动调整位置保持在视口内

# Context Menu 设计规范

- 默认外观参考 Linear 问题列表的右键菜单。实色面板圆角 12 px，选项高至少 32 px，行内圆角 8 px，图文间距 8 px。普通操作起止留白 8／12 px，选择行给行尾勾选预留 32 px。键盘高亮留在选项内部。面板与子菜单使用同一浅深配色。

- 右键（触屏为长按）菜单不容易被发现：菜单里的每个操作都必须在界面其他地方也能完成，如工具栏按钮或 Dropdown Menu。
- `ContextMenu.Trigger` 包住响应右键的区域。需要将普通容器加入键盘顺序时，添加 `tabindex={0}` 和可访问名称。聚焦后可按 Shift+F10 或菜单键，Escape 关闭并归焦。
- 操作用 `onSelect`，复选和单选分别用 `CheckboxItem` 和 `RadioItem`。行尾的 `ContextMenu.Shortcut` 仅提示快捷键。确认流程可以由中性色菜单项打开，确认按钮再使用危险色。
- 父菜单与子菜单根据锚点和可用空间定位，内容过长时在各自的菜单内滚动。
- 可搜索的子面板用 `SubTrigger aria-haspopup="dialog"` 和具名的 `SubContent role="dialog"`，内部放 Command 输入与选项列表。打开时聚焦输入，确认后关闭主菜单，Escape 返回子菜单入口。
- 不要用它替代浏览器在输入框、链接上的原生右键菜单。

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		MenuSub as SdkSub,
		type MenuController,
		type MenuOpenChangeReason,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/menu";
	import type { ChangeDetails } from "@ui-sdk/core";
	import { getContext, setContext, type Snippet } from "svelte";
	import { CONTEXT_MENU_SUB_POLICY_KEY, type ContextMenuDismissPolicy } from "./context.js";

	const PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY = Symbol.for("valar-dialog-parent-escape");

	let {
		open = $bindable(),
		defaultOpen,
		loop,
		delay,
		controller,
		onOpenChange,
		onOpenChangeComplete,
		children,
	}: {
		open?: boolean;
		defaultOpen?: boolean;
		loop?: boolean;
		delay?: number;
		controller?: MenuController<unknown>;
		onOpenChange?: (open: boolean, details?: ChangeDetails<MenuOpenChangeReason>) => void;
		onOpenChangeComplete?: (open: boolean) => void;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	let policy = $state<ContextMenuDismissPolicy>({});
	let triggerEl: HTMLElement | null = null;
	const parentEscape = getContext<(() => void) | undefined>(PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY);
	setContext(CONTEXT_MENU_SUB_POLICY_KEY, {
		set(next: ContextMenuDismissPolicy) {
			policy = next;
		},
		setTrigger(el: HTMLElement | null) {
			triggerEl = el;
		},
	});

	function handleOpenChange(next: boolean, details: ChangeDetails<MenuOpenChangeReason>) {
		const isEscapeKey =
			details.reason === "escape-key" &&
			(!(details.event instanceof KeyboardEvent) || details.event.key === "Escape");
		if (!next) {
			if (
				isEscapeKey &&
				(policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				if (policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore") {
					parentEscape?.();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (isEscapeKey && policy.onEscapeKeydown) {
				const event = new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", cancelable: true });
				policy.onEscapeKeydown(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
		}
		onOpenChange?.(next, details);
		if (!next && !details.canceled && details.reason === "escape-key") {
			details.event?.stopPropagation();
			const target = triggerEl;
			queueMicrotask(() => {
				if (target?.isConnected && document.activeElement !== target) {
					target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
				}
			});
		}
	}
</script>

<SdkSub
	bind:open
	{defaultOpen}
	{loop}
	{delay}
	{controller}
	onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
	{onOpenChangeComplete}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SdkSub>

{@render children?.()}
{/if} {/snippet}

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		Menu as SdkMenu,
		type MenuActionDetails,
		type MenuCheckedChangeDetails,
		type MenuController,
		type MenuDismissReason,
		type MenuOpenChangeReason,
		type MenuPayloadChangeReason,
		type MenuValueChangeDetails,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/menu";
	import type { ChangeDetails, DismissAttemptDetails } from "@ui-sdk/core";
	import { getContext, setContext, type Snippet } from "svelte";
	import { CONTEXT_MENU_POLICY_KEY, type ContextMenuDismissPolicy } from "./context.js";

	const PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY = Symbol.for("valar-dialog-parent-escape");

	let {
		open = $bindable(),
		defaultOpen,
		modal: modalProp,
		loop,
		delay,
		dismissible,
		controller,
		container,
		dir: _dir,
		onOpenChange,
		onOpenChangeComplete,
		onPayloadChange,
		onAction,
		onCheckedChange,
		onValueChange,
		onDismissAttempt,
		children,
	}: {
		open?: boolean;
		defaultOpen?: boolean;
		modal?: boolean | "pointer";
		loop?: boolean;
		delay?: number;
		dismissible?: boolean;
		controller?: MenuController<unknown>;
		container?: Element | DocumentFragment | null;
		dir?: "ltr" | "rtl";
		onOpenChange?: (open: boolean, details?: ChangeDetails<MenuOpenChangeReason>) => void;
		onOpenChangeComplete?: (open: boolean) => void;
		onPayloadChange?: (
			payload: unknown,
			details: ChangeDetails<MenuPayloadChangeReason>
		) => void;
		onAction?: (value: string, details: MenuActionDetails) => unknown;
		onCheckedChange?: (checked: boolean, details: MenuCheckedChangeDetails) => void;
		onValueChange?: (value: string, details: MenuValueChangeDetails) => void;
		onDismissAttempt?: (details: DismissAttemptDetails<MenuDismissReason>) => void;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	let policy = $state<ContextMenuDismissPolicy>({});
	let policyReady = $state(typeof document === "undefined");
	const parentEscape = getContext<(() => void) | undefined>(PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY);
	setContext(CONTEXT_MENU_POLICY_KEY, {
		set(next: ContextMenuDismissPolicy) {
			policy = next;
		},
	});

	$effect(() => {
		policyReady = true;
	});

	const resolvedModal = $derived(
		modalProp ??
			(policy.trapFocus === false ||
			policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "ignore" ||
			policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore"
				? false
				: undefined)
	);
	const resolvedOpen = $derived(open === undefined ? undefined : policyReady ? open : false);

	function handleOpenChange(next: boolean, details: ChangeDetails<MenuOpenChangeReason>) {
		if (!next) {
			if (
				(details.reason === "outside-press" ||
					details.reason === "focus-out" ||
					details.reason === "window-blur") &&
				(policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				return;
			}
			if (
				details.reason === "escape-key" &&
				(policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				if (policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore") {
					parentEscape?.();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (details.reason === "outside-press" && policy.onInteractOutside) {
				const event = new CustomEvent("interactOutside", {
					cancelable: true,
					detail: { originalEvent: details.event },
				});
				policy.onInteractOutside(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
			if (details.reason === "escape-key" && policy.onEscapeKeydown) {
				const event = new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", cancelable: true });
				policy.onEscapeKeydown(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
		}
		onOpenChange?.(next, details);
		if (!next && !details.canceled && details.reason === "escape-key") {
			details.event?.stopPropagation();
		}
	}
</script>

<SdkMenu
	bind:open={
		() => resolvedOpen,
		(next) => {
			if (open !== undefined) open = next;
		}
	}
	{defaultOpen}
	modal={resolvedModal}
	{loop}
	{delay}
	presentation="popover"
	{dismissible}
	{controller}
	{container}
	onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
	{onOpenChangeComplete}
	{onPayloadChange}
	{onAction}
	{onCheckedChange}
	{onValueChange}
	{onDismissAttempt}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SdkMenu>
